<!-- pr-reviewer: 1888c30749a5d1929e110c5bd5082fc128717579 -->
Code review clean. Resolve the merge conflict before merge. Label: `conflicts`.

This is a safety-tier review because the change affects posted G-code.

- Fanuc, Doosan and Mazak refuse a positive G83 dwell by name. Their zero-dwell cycles still work.
- Haas includes dwell in the cycle signature and writes P0 to clear the previous dwell.
- The tests cover the refusals, milliseconds, dwell changes and zero reset. The decision file records the control limits.
- No UI files changed. Screenshots are not required.

Local build and tests

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425` failed in `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_haas.nc:37`. Main adds decimal points. This PR adds P0. I aborted the merge, as the review rules require, and tested the unchanged PR head. These results do not verify the combined tree. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; plan only.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: 528 passed, zero failed.
- App library: 313 passed, one ignored.
- App `bore_cycle`: 3 passed; `commands_undo`: 30 passed; `conformance`: 7 passed; `mcp`: 22 passed.
- App `operations`: 119 passed, six ignored.
- App `post_cycle_feed_spindle`: 8 passed; `ream_cycle`: 3 passed; `recorded_post_streams`: 5 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Mutation checks

I ran both mutations separately in the review worktree and restored the file after each check.

1. Remove dwell from the Haas G83 signature. `haas_g83_updates_dwell_in_an_open_cycle_group` failed: one G83 block instead of two. Restore the line: passed.
2. Remove unconditional P output for Haas G83. `haas_g83_zero_dwell_clears_modal_p` failed: the second G83 block had no P0. Restore the condition: passed.

Goldens and sources

I checked all seven added or changed golden files line by line. Six bore files come from parent PR #1821. This PR adds only P0 to the G83 line in `synth_haas.nc`. The tests reproduce these files. The [Haas G83 reference](https://legacy-aem.haascnc.com/content/haascnc/en/service/codes-settings.type=gcode.machine=mill.value=G83.html) documents reuse of dwell. The [Haas G04 reference](https://legacy-aem.haascnc.com/content/haascnc/en/service/codes-settings.type=gcode.machine=mill.value=G04.html) documents modal P and integer milliseconds.

Requested code changes: none.

At merge time, refresh after parent #1821. Keep main's decimal formatting and this PR's P0 in the conflicting golden. Run the relevant tests on that result. No real control was tested. The full quick, batch and release gates were not run in this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Stopped before push because the merged tree has two parent #1821 test failures.

The requested conflict resolution keeps main’s decimal formatting and this PR’s P0 in synth_haas.nc. The pin is `conformance::the_synthesized_stream_locks_the_tool_and_spindle_words`. Removing P0 failed. Restoring it passed. Removing the G83 coordinate decimals failed. Restoring them passed. All seven `g83_dwell` tests passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is red in post `bore_cycle`:
- `the_named_posts_post_the_bore_byte_exact`: the inherited Fanuc golden expects coordinates without main’s decimal points.
- `expanding_posts_rapid_out_of_the_bored_hole_and_keep_the_dwell`: main refuses expanded Heidenhain G86 without spindle-stop support. I kept that refusal.

The remaining app gate stage was stopped after these failures were established. Clippy passed for camcraft-post and camcraft-app, all targets, with warnings denied.

Local merge commit: f1b38c1307d44d381cd77874cbc11a82cbc8c964 on fix-2048-review. It is not pushed. The PR head remains 1888c30749a5d1929e110c5bd5082fc128717579. Parent #1821 is still open; the review asked for this refresh after that parent. These parent failures are outside the latest review findings. Please re-review after the parent compatibility fixes and a green gate.

Stopped without pushing. The quick gate is red on two inherited parent bore-cycle tests.

The requested conflict fix keeps main's decimal formatting and this PR's P0 in synth_haas.nc. The existing conformance test `the_synthesized_stream_locks_the_tool_and_spindle_words` pins both. Removing P0 failed. Restoring it passed. Removing the G83 decimals failed. Restoring them passed.

All seven g83_dwell tests passed. All four expanded_bore_refusal tests passed, including `heidenhain_refuses_expanded_bore`. Main's safety refusal is preserved. Clippy passed for camcraft-post and camcraft-app, all targets, with warnings denied.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` failed in `bore_cycle`:
- `the_named_posts_post_the_bore_byte_exact`: the inherited Fanuc golden lacks main's decimal points.
- `expanding_posts_rapid_out_of_the_bored_hole_and_keep_the_dwell`: expects expanded Heidenhain G86 that main now refuses for spindle-stop safety.

Remaining gate stages were stopped after those failures. These tests are outside the requested findings and were left unchanged.

Local merge commit: 4daf264554f322e99f225a240aa9e190ad5a903b on fix-2048-current. It is not pushed. The PR head remains 1888c30749a5d1929e110c5bd5082fc128717579. Please re-review after the parent compatibility fixes and a green gate.

The requested conflict resolution is verified locally. Nothing was pushed because the quick gate is red.

The Haas golden keeps main's decimal coordinates and this PR's P0. `the_synthesized_stream_locks_the_tool_and_spindle_words` pins both. Removing P0 failed. Restoring it passed. Removing the G83 decimals failed. Restoring them passed.

All seven `g83_dwell` tests passed. All four `expanded_bore_refusal` tests passed, including `heidenhain_refuses_expanded_bore`. Main's safety refusal remains intact. Clippy passed for camcraft-post and camcraft-app, all targets, with warnings denied.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` failed on two inherited parent bore-cycle tests. The post stage had 620 passes and two failures:
- `the_named_posts_post_the_bore_byte_exact`: the Fanuc golden lacks main's decimal points.
- `expanding_posts_rapid_out_of_the_bored_hole_and_keep_the_dwell`: expects expanded Heidenhain G86 that main refuses for spindle-stop safety.

The remaining app stage was stopped. These failures are outside the requested findings and were left unchanged.

Local merge head: 10011c8322f78dadcf68c70d46608c7b1b0cdf5f. It is not pushed. The PR head remains 1888c30749a5d1929e110c5bd5082fc128717579. Please re-review after the parent compatibility fixes and a green gate.

The requested conflict resolution is verified locally. It keeps main's decimal coordinates and this PR's P0 in synth_haas.nc.

The existing conformance test `the_synthesized_stream_locks_the_tool_and_spindle_words` pins both. Removing P0 failed. Restoring it passed. Removing G83 decimal formatting failed. Restoring it passed. All seven g83_dwell tests and all four expanded_bore_refusal tests passed, including heidenhain_refuses_expanded_bore.

The full quick gate completed red. Post had 620 passes and two inherited bore_cycle failures: the Fanuc golden lacks decimals, and the expansion test expects Heidenhain G86 that main refuses. App tests also fail to compile at crates/app/tests/bore_cycle.rs:50 because OpParams::Drill now requires break_through. All-target clippy for camcraft-post and camcraft-app fails on that same missing field.

These inherited failures are outside the latest review findings and were left unchanged. Nothing was pushed. The PR head remains 1888c30749a5d1929e110c5bd5082fc128717579. Local merge head: 7557dae81310b4b5f7a0d90491bc4914145c6b19.

Please re-review after the parent compatibility fixes and a green gate.

The requested conflict resolution is verified locally. The Haas golden keeps main's decimal coordinates and this PR's P0.

`the_synthesized_stream_locks_the_tool_and_spindle_words` pins both. Removing P0 failed; restoring it passed. Removing G83 decimals failed; restoring them passed. All seven g83_dwell tests and all four expanded_bore_refusal tests passed, including main's Heidenhain safety refusal.

Nothing was pushed. The quick gate is red on two inherited bore_cycle tests: byte-exact goldens lack decimals, and the expansion test expects Heidenhain G86 that main refuses. The app build and all-target clippy also fail in upstream/main's wire_tool.rs:106-107: CuttingRow requires stepdown and stepover, and material requires Option<WorkMaterial>. Remaining gate stages were stopped after these blockers were established. These failures are outside the requested review findings and were left unchanged.

Local merge head: ecebd3375c11a9fc22ceb889035871b247f0d179. PR head remains 1888c30749a5d1929e110c5bd5082fc128717579. Please re-review after the parent/main compatibility fixes and a green gate.
